traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text:
The rakklethorn toad has advantage on Wisdom
(Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one
target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Thorn Volley
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 50 ft.,
one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target must
succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned
for 1 hour.
